transfer.title: Transfer {security}
transfer.description: Moves shares from {account} without selling them. The receiving account takes over their share of the cost basis ({costBasis} for {quantity} shares today), and neither account realizes a gain.

transfer.deleteEffect: The shares return to {from}, and both accounts' holdings and gains are recalculated.
